question: Do the independently certified opposite-face sign strip and complete positive partial_kappa G interval concern exactly the same selected normalized real functional on the same rectangle, so that IVT and MVT certify one unique kappa-transverse root for every fixed lambda and a continuous unique selector on the closed lambda slab?

upstream_results.role: supplies joint continuity of the selected normalized G, a uniformly nonzero Q0 chart and strict negative/positive complete-tail values on the left/right kappa faces
supplies ordinary fixed-lambda differentiability in the corridor interior and a uniform strict-positive complete partial_kappa G interval

declared_scope.selected_actual_family: the same real plus-recessive family selected by the pinned Q>=4 Liouville-Green construction; its common nonzero switch amplitude is divided out
declared_scope.signstrip_reference_instantiation: p^2=(2/3)kappa^2 and A_0=x^2-kappa^2; write the same pinned reference as c_kappa on the real kappa corridor
declared_scope.derivative_scope: ordinary fixed-lambda partial_kappa on the corridor interior and the corresponding one-sided derivative at each kappa face

hypotheses: G is jointly continuous on the closed K times Lambda rectangle
for every fixed lambda, G is differentiable in kappa on the open corridor
partial_kappa G is uniformly bounded below by a strictly positive constant on the open corridor
conclusions: IVT gives at least one open-corridor zero for every fixed lambda
MVT makes kappa maps to G(kappa,lambda) strictly increasing, so that zero is unique
the unique normalized G zero is simple and transverse with respect to kappa
joint continuity, compactness and uniqueness give one continuous selector kappa_star(lambda) on the closed lambda slab
calculus_theorem.not_used: No root solve, interval Newton step, implicit-function derivative, partial_lambda G, mixed derivative, spectral argument or RAQ argument is used.

assumptions: The sign-strip p notation is bridged to the positive real kappa notation only through its exact p^2=(2/3)kappa^2 reference instantiation; no raw string equality between c_p and c_kappa is assumed.
The ordinary derivative is required only in the open kappa corridor. The one-sided face derivatives are not used by IVT or MVT.
The uniformly nonzero u_plus(Q0) chart makes zeros of normalized G and the selected declared Gamma_1 equivalent on this rectangle, but supplies no absolute Gamma_1 amplitude or orientation.
The continuous selector conclusion uses only joint continuity, compactness and uniqueness. No C1, differentiable or analytic lambda dependence is claimed.
The claim is one root per fixed lambda inside this declared corridor, not a global root census and not a nonreal spectral statement.
